review.official:
Haze is an
Operator
from
Victoria
, where she did time in an
Infected
quarantine lockup. She finally escaped after multiple attempts, eventually joining
Rhodes Island
under an alias.

files.description:
Imaging tests for this Operator showed blurry outlines of internal organs with visible dark spots. Unusually high concentrations of Originium particles were present in her circulatory system, indicating infection and confirming her as Infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 16% 
No visible signs of crystal formation, but comparatively worse internal contamination. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.36u/L 
Infection entering mid-stage, crystals are starting to enhance the host's Originium abilities.
Haze is able to cast Dark Fog Arts, a spell unique to her. The versatile mist can obscure vision, damage, kill, or enhance Haze's own abilities.

Haze has a habit of palming things from those around her. While she never steals money or keys, no trifling trinkets are safe with her around. Such trivial thievery wouldn't normally get anyone in serious trouble, but upon getting picked up for a minor infraction, her infection was discovered, so the authorities dumped her into a cell for the Infected.

Her prison was especially built to hold Infected criminals. To break out and breathe free once more, she had to climb the towering quarantine wall and evade all security measures in between. Haze is the only one to have managed such a feat, with the Victorian Police still hunting her to this day.

Haze makes no secret of her fondness for feline Beast Stewards. Even though these same cute animals led to her infection, she still feeds and cares for them. So it's no surprise Haze gets along with other Felines like Mousse.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Didn't notice me behind you, eh? It's only natural. I'm a cat. We're known for being silent prowlers!

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Hey, don't touch my hat... it's crazy, you know! If it feeds you too many secrets, Doctor, you'll be in trouble.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: So rare to see a pharma take in runaway kitties from a jail. Did you all want a peek at my maps? Or,  was it some advice on prison breaks?

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: We thieves have our own principles and standards too... perhaps. Who can say?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Meow, meow, meow... Meow? Never you mind, I'm just talking to myself.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Anytime you want. Don't you worry, I have friends everywhere. Eyes everywhere.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Curiosity can kill a cat, you know.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm in a good mood right now, so here's a riddle for you. 'Why is a raven like a writing desk?'

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Thank you, for this 'Haze' I'm now.But... did you catch a peep of any of them, along the way? Any of, well... my secrets?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Asleep like a baby... Time to get 'meown to business,' then.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello, I'm Haze. I like relaxing work environments, and an employer who knows better than to bother me with too many questions.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Yummy.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Promotion? What's that? Does it taste good?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Finally out of those old shackles... and here I am, straight into new ones. The destiny of a thief's no wonder.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Give me a bit of freedom and I'll be happy.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: What do we need a leader for? Can't everyone just fight on their own?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Meow... It's driving me wild... this sweet, sweet smell of freedom!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Everyone, no need to have cold feet here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Meow?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Here we go.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Out and about.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Like a shadow.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: How do nya like this?

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Careful, kittens. Don't lose your mittens.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: You think you've got all the trimmings, don't you?

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Nah-ah-ah, Don't get carried away.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: No one stands above a kitty in the end!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Perfect victory? Whatever. A victory's a victory afterall.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Do you know how many enemies you let go? That will be a spanner in the works.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I'm no stranger to running for it, but this is just too embarrassing...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Kotatsu. Where's the kotatsu?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Meow?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Meow? I'm not satisfied yet. You know my rule: if I can't have it, I want it.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: New year? A year is such a long time for a kitty. And happiness won't come knocking if one worries about more than just today. Speaking of which, today is really nice for napping. Doctor, how about we just spend this day with some lazy, cozy naps.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, nice to meet nya.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. Meow? My best wishes aren't enough? Don't tell me you want some presents, you greedy kitty. Well then, what do you want? Shall I give you a riddle, or allow you to rub my ears?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: A kitty visits gardens that provide food. But if someone tries to lock the kitty up, it will surely run away. When the kitty's in a good mood, however, it can bring back some tasty stuff as thanks. Know what I mean, Doctor? Be sure to make Rhodes Island a garden that everyone likes.
